definitions.explanation: A painting technique using oil-based pigments, or a work of art created using this technique. Refers to both the method and the finished work.

examples.japanese: {油彩|ゆさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: To paint a landscape in oils.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{油彩|ゆさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This art museum has many masterpieces in oil painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{油彩|ゆさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: She said she's better at oil painting than watercolor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil) and {彩|さい} (coloring, painting). Often contrasted with ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧ (watercolor). The longer form ⟦{油彩画|ゆさいが}→油彩画：24181_yusaiga⟧ specifically refers to an oil painting as a finished work, while {油彩|ゆさい} can refer to either the technique or the work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{油彩画|ゆさいが}→油彩画：24181_yusaiga⟧ — oil painting (the artwork)
- {油彩|ゆさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ — to paint in oils
- {油彩|ゆさい}⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧ — oil painting technique
- {油彩|ゆさい}⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧ — oil paint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧ — oil painting; the everyday word, more common in casual conversation
- ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧ — watercolor; painting with water-soluble pigments
- ⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧ — Japanese-style painting; traditional painting using mineral pigments and sumi ink
